card.name: Inside brand and surname names
card.fires_on: Partway through a rare brand name or surname, on a middle piece where the name is not yet complete. Seen in capitalised drug brand names and in author names in reference lists.

modes.label: Brand drug names
modes.description: Middle piece of an uppercase or capitalised brand name for a drug.
modes.example: Patients receiving ULTOM<<IR>>IS are at increased risk for invasive disease

modes.label: Author surnames
modes.description: Middle piece of an uncommon surname in a citation list.
modes.example: Dallwitz, M.J., McJann<<et>>, C.L. and Consaul,

modes.label: Other mid-name pieces
modes.description: Piece inside a place or generic drug name.
modes.example: Hydrocodone Bitartrate and Homat<<rop>>ine Methylbromide Oral Solution

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly proper-name endings such as Peak, Heights, Airlines and 号, suggesting it helps finish a proper name.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of an unusual brand or surname that is still being spelled out.
